name: Artificial intelligence
summary: Choose York-supported AI tools and guidance

details.title: Find the right AI tool
details.html: York provides access to supported AI tools for learning, teaching, research and administrative work. Student access includes Microsoft Copilot through their Microsoft 365 account; other tools and premium features have different eligibility or licensing requirements

details.title: York AI services
details.html: The published employee service describes YU AURA, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot and Zoom AI Companion. These are distinct products with different capabilities, approved uses and access conditions

details.title: Handle university information safely
details.html: Do not enter confidential, proprietary or sensitive York data into public consumer AI services. Check York’s approved tools and data-use requirements before submitting any institutional content to an AI system
